title: Architecture
exit_criteria: E7 evidence and dependencies justify legacy writer retirement (→ unblock E8).
E8 unblocks E9 (→ effect interpreter work begins).
E9 unblocks ELMIZATION02 (→ authority-domain recon starts).
The `NEEDS_CLASSIFICATION` historical rows (`ARCH-01`, `ARCH-02`) get a bounded reclassification ACT.

items.title: E8 — legacy writer retirement
items.description: Retire the remaining legacy writer authority, but only when E7 evidence and dependencies justify it. Explicitly HELD: no action in this board ACT. Reopen condition: E7 evidence and dependencies justify legacy writer retirement.
blockers: E7 evidence and dependencies must justify legacy writer retirement before E8 can be unblocked.
reopen_conditions: E7 evidence and dependencies justify legacy writer retirement (→ unblock E8).

items.title: E9 — effect interpreter
items.description: Bounded effect execution / interpreter work, sequenced AFTER E8. Explicitly HELD: no action in this board ACT. Reopen condition: E8 unblocks E9, at which point the effect interpreter work begins.
blockers: E8 (legacy writer retirement) must complete before E9 (effect interpreter) begins.
reopen_conditions: E8 unblocks E9 (→ effect interpreter work begins).

items.title: EPIC-CLINEMM-ELMIZATION02 — authority-domain migration
items.description: Migrate deterministic behavioral authority where doing so reduces duplicated state/policy decisions. Target direction: Elm → deterministic state transitions / policy / projections; TypeScript → VS Code APIs + effects; React → rendering / DOM/event adaptation. Forbidden goal: "Rewrite everything in Elm". First post-E9 action: authority-domain recon. Gated on E9.
blockers: E9 (effect interpreter) must complete before ELMIZATION02's authority-domain recon starts.
reopen_conditions: E9 unblocks ELMIZATION02 (→ authority-domain recon starts).
